verdict.rationale: Gitea's docs say it supports a Pull Request workflow where reviewers browse code online and leave review comments, and submitters respond or modify code online. The pack never explicitly describes diff comparison views or comments anchored inline to specific lines. missing for 10: explicit documentation of diff/compare views, explicit line-level inline review comments, independent or hands-on corroboration of the PR review experience.

support.subject: As a developer, I can open a pull request, compare diffs, and leave inline review comments alongside the code

citations.quote: Code review supports both the Pull Request workflow and AGit workflow. Reviewers can browse code online and provide review comments or feedback.
Submitters can receive review comments and respond or modify code online.
